name: Mountain lake
desc: Arrival, stillness, a decision made in the open - vast quiet with nowhere to hide and nothing to interrupt.
tags: scenery, no humans, alpine lake, still water, mirror reflection, snow capped mountains, pine treeline on far shore, grey boulders at waterline, mountain range, clear sky
prose: a still alpine lake mirroring snow-capped mountains, a dark pine treeline along the far shore and grey boulders breaking the waterline in the foreground
note: The reflection is the shot and it is the first thing dropped - still water and mirror reflection both have to be named or the surface goes choppy and the mountains stop repeating. Foreground boulders are the only thing giving it scale; without them it flattens into wallpaper with no depth cue at all.
